description: real Crossref records (trimmed) for the DBLP sample works
license: Crossref metadata: Crossref states bibliographic metadata are facts free to reuse without restriction; abstracts may be publisher copyright and are excluded here. Terms to be re-confirmed by the human at https://www.crossref.org/documentation/retrieve-metadata/rest-api/
selection_rule: DBLP works = every record of datasets/samples/dblp/dblp-sample-50.xml (the 50 records of selection-10k with the smallest sha256(seed|key), seed scholarchain-dblp-2026-11-16); for each, the DOI-verified Crossref response and DOI-verified OpenAlex work(s) from the 2026-11-22 retrieval; lines sorted by dblp_key
trim_rule: Crossref message fields kept: DOI, type, title, container-title, short-container-title, publisher, member, prefix, issued, published, ISSN, ISBN, volume, issue, page, reference-count, is-referenced-by-count, author; author[] fields kept: given, family, name, sequence, ORCID, authenticated-orcid; everything else dropped (notably abstract, reference, license, link, relation, assertion).
